Loss report: tekton -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/ci expr.opaque (expression has no translation from tekton)
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
